item.text: [{"task_id":"5af49b42","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    minimum_length = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    step = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if step <= 0:","        return np.full(grid.shape, bg, dtype=int)","    height, width = grid.shape","    templates = []","    covered = set()","    for r in range(height):","        c = 0","        while c < width:","            if int(grid[r, c]) == bg:","                c += step","                continue","            start = c","            sequence = []","            positions = []","            while c < width and int(grid[r, c]) != bg:","                sequence.append(int(grid[r, c]))","                positions.append((r, c))","                c += step","            if len(sequence) >= minimum_length:","                templates.append(sequence)","                covered.update(positions)","    for r in range(height):","        for c in range(width):","            color = int(grid[r, c])","            if color == bg or (r, c) in covered:","                continue","            for sequence in templates:","                if color in sequence:","                    anchor = sequence.index(color)","                    for j in range(len(sequence)):","                        target = c + (j - anchor) * step","                        if 0 <= target < width:","                            out[r, target] = sequence[j]","                    break","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,1]},"rationale":"Read contiguous horizontal color sequences as templates.
